items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: I know George Davis. And, uh, Warren Parker... he wanted to form a record company. Yeah. And he got in touch with us. And we recorded, Tell It Like It Is.

ctx.x: That's what it took off. Right. And made Al Hurt a name, uh, around the country, around the world. Right. And, uh, I didn't get any royalties until, uh, uh, uh, I'm trying to think what year it was that I, I mean, that was a, the hit, it was a hit in 64, I think like. Okay. Yeah. So, okay. So, uh, I, uh, was out in California with, uh, AFO and my sister died and I came back to New Orleans. Mm-hmm. And I had been home about a month and a half and George Davis called me and said,
Hey, man, we're with Lil' Richard and he wants you to need a baritone. Okay.
